# Umbraco Skills

Each skill folder contains a `SKILL.md` instruction file for an AI coding agent.

## Included skills

- `umbraco-content-ops`: bulk content and media operations
- `umbraco-schema-workflow`: document/data type modeling tasks
- `umbraco-troubleshooting`: logs, diagnostics, and safe remediation

## Suggested usage

Prompt examples:
- "Use the umbraco-content-ops skill to bulk update and republish selected nodes."
- "Use the umbraco-schema-workflow skill to scaffold a new document type family."
- "Use the umbraco-troubleshooting skill to analyze management API failures."
